opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct publishable educational research addressing a key question in physiological education.
opportunities.summary: Supports members to develop new educational resources or conduct publishable educational research in physiology.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop new techniques, or finalise a physiological project and promote knowledge transfer.
opportunities.summary: Supports members to conduct pilot studies, develop new techniques, and promote knowledge transfer and impact in physiology.

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow; members hosting events at their organisation.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who require additional support to achieve their full potential.
opportunities.summary: Supports postdoctoral researchers with funding for consumables, registration for fellowships, and other justified expenses to advance physiology research.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full member or Fellow in their second year of membership or longer.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for members to run activities that address equity, diversity, and inclusion principles in physiological sciences.
